_comment: Copy to config.json, or select another path with ARTIFEX_CONFIG. Only database and skill_dir are read from this file. Configure LLM options through environment variables or application settings.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. ARTIFEX_PG_DSN overrides database. Use either individual fields below or database.dsn with a complete connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Alternative: replace database above with this DSN form. A nonempty dsn overrides individual fields.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root: each child directory contains SKILL.md. Precedence: ARTIFEX_SKILL_DIR, this field, then skills/ beside the executable. Omit or leave empty for the default. Relative paths resolve against the working directory.
